subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline first, or require the broader daily/week calendar, stats, drag-and-drop, and validation design before implementation?
rationale: The current code has no broken existing contract; this is a Control UI product-scope decision, and the open implementation PR only covers part of the requested behavior while also needing rebase/repair.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or rebuild the linked PR on the current cron page, preserve current contracts, and accept a 24-hour timeline as the first intentional slice while tracking broader calendar/editor work separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers define the daily, weekly, stats, drag-and-drop, and validator behavior as one product surface.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR if maintainers decide the current list/run-history UI is sufficient for core for now.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or rebuild the linked PR on the current cron page, preserve current contracts, and accept a 24-hour timeline as the first intentional slice while tracking broader calendar/editor work separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman authored the largest current Control UI cron management slice, making them the best available routing owner from merged history for the product-scope decision.
